seating.notes: Aino-Kaarina must sit directly next to Päivikki in the front row. Left-to-right order is not specified, so confirm with Itzel. Ask the quinta to reserve both seats and, if available, provide a hearing loop or a speaker close to them.

photographer: TBD - alternative to be shortlisted and confirmed (Lumière Fotografia must NOT be booked). Coverage 16:00 to about 22:00 or later.
venue_notes: DATE UNRESOLVED: the wedding is planned for Saturday 12 September 2026 but the system date is 13 October 2026, after that date. Make no binding bookings, payments or confirmations until Itzel confirms the date. Enquiries and holds only.

No vendor quotes or confirmations have been received. Budget total_eur of 0 means nothing is committed or quoted yet. The 42,000 EUR cap is hard, all quotes must include VAT and service charges, and fireworks must be priced separately so they can be cut first.
Children count in dietary_counts is a placeholder 0 and not a real figure. The number is awaiting Itzel. Ask the caterer for their cut-off date for numbers.

Nut-free is a serious allergy (Eero's nephew carries an EpiPen). Require written confirmation of nut-free preparation, ingredient checks on all suppliers including cake and desserts, and cross-contamination controls. No almonds in the cake.
Chapel sound: microphone (lapel or handheld) for Päivikki, plus whatever the officiant needs. Hearing loop or speaker near the front-row seats of Aino-Kaarina and Päivikki, if available.
Menu cards in Spanish and English. Add Finnish only if more than 25 of Eero's family confirm. Ask the printer or caterer for lead time and hold the decision until the count is known.

Heat contingency: if the forecast is above 32°C, cocktails move from the olive grove to the wine cellar. Confirm the cellar is available at 17:15, its capacity for 96 guests, the trigger deadline (48h or 24h ahead) and the caterer's set-up for either location.
Schedule contingency: if the ceremony starts late, shorten the cocktail hour so dinner stays at 19:30. Inform the caterer and DJ. The ceremony is never shortened.
DJ brief: do not play Macarena (written do-not-play item). Confirm hours run to the 01:30 last shuttle, sound check, and chapel sound set-up if the DJ supplies it.
Dog: tell the quinta Pimienta is coming. Ask about pet policy, a waiting place before and after the ceremony, lead requirement, whether caterer areas must be kept clear, and any extra fee or deposit.
Shuttle: confirm the quinta or a transport firm can run shuttles to the hotel until 01:30. Hotel name still needed from Itzel.
Photographer: shortlist alternatives with availability for the date, coverage 16:00 to about 22:00 or later, and VAT-inclusive prices.
Open questions for Itzel: confirmed date, number of children, count of Eero's family confirmed, hotel name, nut-free and vegetarian details, budget breakdown so far, and whether fireworks are booked.
